nodes.summary: For positive-semidefinite complex matrices `A` and `B` and reals `q ≥ 0`, `0 ≤ r ≤ 1`, `tr (A^{r/2} B^r A^{r/2})^q ≤ tr (A^{1/2} B A^{1/2})^{rq}` (H. Araki, Lett. Math. Phys. 19 (1990) 167–170; K. M. R. Audenaert, arXiv:math/0701129, Theorem 1, the case `0 ≤ r ≤ 1`).

Araki, Lett. Math. Phys. 19 (1990) 167–170; K. M. R. Audenaert, arXiv:math/0701129, Theorem 1), stated in the exact form of the wanted `MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ArakiLiebThirringWanted.araki_lieb_thirring`, and the case `t = 2` of the…
nodes.title: Lieb–Thirring trace inequality for `t = 2`

nodes.summary: For positive-semidefinite complex matrices `A` and `B` and reals `q ≥ 0`, `r ≥ 1`, `tr (A^{1/2} B A^{1/2})^{rq} ≤ tr (A^{r/2} B^r A^{r/2})^q` (H. Araki, Lett. Math. Phys. 19 (1990) 167–170; K. M. R. Audenaert, arXiv:math/0701129, Theorem 1, the case `r ≥ 1`). Both traces are real because both matrices are positive semidefinite; the statement compares their real parts.
nodes.title: Araki–Lieb–Thirring inequality

nodes.summary: For Hermitian `X` and `Y`, with `C = XY - YX`, `tr (C* C) = 2 (tr (X X Y Y) - tr (X Y X Y))`.
nodes.title: Commutator identity for traces

nodes.summary: For Hermitian complex matrices `X` and `Y`, `tr (X Y X Y) ≤ tr (X X Y Y)` in the partial order of `ℂ`: the difference is the nonnegative real `tr (C* C) / 2` with `C = XY - YX`. It is the case `t = 2` of the Lieb–Thirring trace inequality (E. A. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
